newsitem.title: USA: Chicago city panel advances TIF development plans.
newsitem.headline: Chicago city panel advances TIF development plans.

text.p: A Chicago City Council panel advanced plans Thursday to designate an area north of downtown as a tax increment finance district, a committee spokesman said.

Finance Committee members approved the designation as part of a plan to fund a $281 million redevelopment of an area that includes the Cabrini-Green public housing complex north of downtown, spokesman Donal Quinlan said.
The recommendation now goes to the City Council which meets next on July 30, Quinlan said.
The district would include about 340 acres encompassing one of the oldest areas of the city, Quinlan said.
Plans include housing for lower, middle and upper income residents and envision new fire, police and library facilities as well, Quinlan said.
